title: Changing the prompt over time
hook: start and end percent are not percent of your steps. They are points on the model's noise scale, so end 0.5 can be 9 of 20 steps, or 17. And a gap in your ranges leaves steps with no prompt at all.

verified.claim: The node only writes start_percent and end_percent.
The lab's percent_to_sigma equals the real discrete and flow functions at the percents tried, on a CPU.
calculate_start_end_timesteps turns percents into sigmas, and get_area_and_mult skips an entry whose range doesn't contain the step's sigma.
A step with no active entry gets a zero prediction for that branch.
A second range node replaces the first one's values.
verified.ref: Real nodes on a CPU, v0.43.0
